note: Written once, at selection time. Nothing downstream reads this file.

candidates.title: One Run, Observed
candidates.pitch: One peach dot is one inference. Born from the sphere eclipse, it lands on a rule and never leaves the rule system: travels into the 0.42 failing cell, steps down to the SQL row, steps down to 72.3% pass. Pull back — the traversed lines are the glyph. The mark was the path.

candidates.title: The Failing Cell
candidates.pitch: Film is an argument with one number. Grid mounts full, cells blank. Tints wash in row by row — greens, then one peach 0.42. Camera holds. Everything after is that cell defended: the SQL that found it, the monitoring that logged it. Ends back on 0.42, unfixed.
candidates.salvaged: Winner takes the hard hold on the failing cell as the film's densest beat, and the refusal to resolve it into success.

candidates.title: Night and Day
candidates.pitch: Marketing is night, tool is daylight. Black editorial frames alternate with pastel product slabs washing up from black — plum tabs, mint persona card, cream eval grid — each returning to black. Colour exists only while work is happening. Ends when the last panel dims and only the peach dot stays lit.
candidates.salvaged: Winner takes 'colour exists only while work happens' — pastel panels wash up from black by luminance and fall back, never bleeding into editorial frames.

decidedBy: Brand specificity then continuity. 'One Run, Observed' comes from the mark's own logic — many parallel runs, one observed — so it can carry no other logo. One dot, one rule, mounted 18s: seven states read as one event. 'Night and Day' is a shot film, nothing survives state change. Winner absorbed the unfixed 0.42 hold and the daylight-tool luminance rule.
